comment: Scheduler stack hierarchy and configuration. All 11 schedulers are deterministic Python/config logic. Claude agents are used only when reasoning is truly required (i.e., routing confidence is low or context ambiguity is high). Consumed by tools/scheduler_lint.py.

scheduler_hierarchy.name: general_scheduler
scheduler_hierarchy.description: Classify prompt into one of 16 task types using keyword/pattern scoring

scheduler_hierarchy.name: intent_scheduler
scheduler_hierarchy.description: Resolve intent via keyword/alias/path/topic index lookup. Never reads source files unless index miss.

scheduler_hierarchy.name: topic_context_scheduler
scheduler_hierarchy.description: Select minimal capsules/files/memory refs. Default max_depth=2. Prefer cached capsules over source files.
scheduler_hierarchy.cheap_path: cached capsules first, source reads only on cache miss

scheduler_hierarchy.name: workflow_scheduler
scheduler_hierarchy.description: Select one strict workflow contract from workflow-manifest-config.json

scheduler_hierarchy.name: model_effort_scheduler
scheduler_hierarchy.description: Advisory tier scheduling: planning/execution/review tiers, plan_frozen, cheap_execution_allowed, escalation_policy
scheduler_hierarchy.constraint: Never emit /model or /effort commands. Tiers are advisory only. Ultracode escalation documented in escalation_policy, not emitted.

scheduler_hierarchy.name: agent_budget_scheduler
scheduler_hierarchy.description: All agents considered. Only allowlist invoked. Unrelated agents skipped with reason. Cap: docs/graph<=5, others<=8.

scheduler_hierarchy.name: skill_scheduler
scheduler_hierarchy.description: Skills from workflow + routing capsule. Selected skills become required procedures in manifest.

scheduler_hierarchy.name: artifact_scheduler
scheduler_hierarchy.description: Artifacts enforced by workflow. Trivial tasks get no artifacts. Auto from task_type_to_artifacts.

scheduler_hierarchy.name: validation_scheduler
scheduler_hierarchy.description: Choose cheapest valid checks per workflow. No broad validation when focused is enough.

scheduler_hierarchy.name: memory_scheduler
scheduler_hierarchy.description: Gate memory writes. Skip for skip_types. Surface domain_join_rules when relevant.

scheduler_hierarchy.name: daemon_index_scheduler
scheduler_hierarchy.description: Graph/index/capsule refresh. Automatic via incremental_brain_daemon. Token-free: never calls Claude, never edits production code.
scheduler_hierarchy.rebuild_on_change: affected capsules and search index only; full rebuild for structural graph/config changes
scheduler_hierarchy.constraint: Never calls Claude. Never edits production code. Never invokes nested Claude CLI.
